What Is a HEIC File and How to Open It on Any Device

Published November 2, 2026 · Ubahin Team

HEIC (High Efficiency Image Container) is the photo format iPhone cameras have used by default since iOS 11. Its files are smaller than JPG at similar quality.

Why is it hard to open?

Not every system and app supports HEIC. Some versions of Windows need an extra extension, and some Android apps and online forms accept only JPG or PNG.

How to convert it

  • Use HEIC to JPG on Ubahin. It runs in your browser, so your photos are not uploaded.
  • Or on your iPhone: Settings › Camera › Formats › choose Most Compatible so new photos are saved as JPG.

What about file size?

After conversion to JPG, the file size usually grows. If needed, shrink it with Compress Image.
